collected_at.description: Collection time as a timezone-qualified RFC3339 timestamp.

pod_count.description: All collected Pods (count), including terminal Pods.

terminal_pods.description: Succeeded/Failed Pods excluded from request totals (count).

allocated.description: Effective requests of scheduled, non-terminal Pods. Counts units of resource_name (default nvidia.com/gpu), not utilization percent or necessarily physical GPU cards; query MIG resource types separately.

running_allocated.description: Effective requests of scheduled Pods in Running phase. Counts units of resource_name (default nvidia.com/gpu), not utilization percent or necessarily physical GPU cards; query MIG resource types separately.

unscheduled_requested.description: Effective requests of non-terminal Pods without a node. Counts units of resource_name (default nvidia.com/gpu), not utilization percent or necessarily physical GPU cards; query MIG resource types separately.

gpu_pods.description: Non-terminal Pods requesting resource_name in this namespace (Pod count).

allocated.description: Effective requests of scheduled, non-terminal Pods. Counts units of resource_name (default nvidia.com/gpu), not utilization percent or necessarily physical GPU cards; query MIG resource types separately.

running_allocated.description: Effective requests of scheduled Pods in Running phase. Counts units of resource_name (default nvidia.com/gpu), not utilization percent or necessarily physical GPU cards; query MIG resource types separately.

unscheduled_requested.description: Effective requests of non-terminal Pods without a node. Counts units of resource_name (default nvidia.com/gpu), not utilization percent or necessarily physical GPU cards; query MIG resource types separately.

gpu_requests.description: Effective Pod request as a count of resource_name units; not utilization percent or memory bytes.
